title: Assembled Book Spec
description: The object that threads all layers together. Produced by the assembler, consumed by the generator, validator, illustrator, and layout steps.

combination_key.description: Used by the variety engine's per-child anti-repeat memory.

allowed_tokens.description: Resolved out-of-level tokens permitted in this book (from personalization + theme).

reference_sheet.description: Generated once per book (or per child series) and threaded into every page illustration prompt for consistency.

character.description: Fixed descriptors: age, hair, skin tone, outfit, expression.

language.description: OPTIONAL (website toggle, OFF by default; unused in standard single-track books). The language-comprehension half of the Simple View of Reading. Enriches the book without raising the child's decodable load. Drives the adult read-aloud track and vocabulary/knowledge goals.

tier2_vocab.description: Rich words introduced ONLY in the adult read-aloud track, defined in kid-friendly terms.

background_knowledge.description: Facts/concepts the theme builds (e.g., 'puppies shake to dry off').

strands.description: Scarborough language-comprehension strands this book touches.

text.description: CHILD track: fully decodable at the book's level. This is what the child reads and what the validator checks.

adult_read_aloud.description: OPTIONAL (website toggle, OFF by default; unused in standard single-track books). ADULT track: a richer line the caregiver reads aloud. NOT decodability-constrained; may use Tier-2 vocabulary and complex syntax. Excluded from decodability/eligibility checks; carries the language-comprehension load.
